# Day AI | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Customer Memory for Internal AI Agents | Verify that providing customer memory to internal AI agents reduces manual maintenance by using “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities - Advancing Phase - Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” as the primary link. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Automatic maintenance of the pipeline | Verify that the automated maintenance pipeline really reduces manual maintenance by using the “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities - Advancing Phase - Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” as the main link. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Retrieving sales engineering issues | The main link, “List or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - push phase” - triggers the next step - manage the double disk, to verify whether the search for sales engineering issues actually reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| cross-team client contact and reset | Using “lists or interactive entry - formation of customers and business opportunities - advance phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - manage the double drive, to verify whether cross-team customers are actually reducing manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
